title: DetailList
responsibility: Renders keyed semantic definition rows while callers provide labels, values and empty content.

inputs.name: DetailList.rows
inputs.description: Caller-defined rows in display order, each passed unchanged to rowKey, label, children and the optional termTitle, valueTitle and valueClass callbacks. An empty array renders the empty content instead, and falsy entries and repeated labels are neither filtered nor deduplicated.

inputs.name: DetailList.rowKey
inputs.description: Called as rowKey(row, position) for each row, where position is the row's index in rows, and its return value becomes the keyed each block key. It must return a stable, unique string or number for each row, so rows that share a label still need distinct keys.

inputs.name: DetailList.label
inputs.description: Required snippet rendered for each row with that row as its argument, placed inside the hx-dt term element. It is not rendered when rows is empty.

inputs.name: DetailList.children
inputs.description: Required snippet rendered for each row with that row as its argument, placed inside the hx-dd description element. It is not rendered when rows is empty.

inputs.name: DetailList.empty
inputs.description: Optional snippet rendered in place of the list when rows is empty; it defaults to undefined, which renders an hx-p paragraph reading No details to display. A supplied snippet replaces that paragraph entirely, so className is not applied to the empty state.

inputs.name: DetailList.className
inputs.description: Optional feature-owned classes appended after the detail-list class on the hx-dl list, or on the hx-p empty-state paragraph when rows is empty and no empty snippet is supplied. Defaults to an empty string, which adds no extra classes.

inputs.name: DetailList.grouped
inputs.description: When true (the default), each term and value pair is wrapped in an hx-div element with class detail-row. When false, the hx-dt and hx-dd elements are direct children of the hx-dl list with no wrapper.

inputs.name: DetailList.termTitle
inputs.description: Optional callback called as termTitle(row) for each rendered row; its return value becomes the title attribute of the hx-dt term element, and an undefined return omits the attribute. It defaults to undefined, which omits the attribute, and errors thrown by the callback propagate.

inputs.name: DetailList.valueTitle
inputs.description: Optional callback called as valueTitle(row) for each rendered row; its return value becomes the title attribute of the hx-dd description element, and an undefined return omits the attribute. It defaults to undefined, which omits the attribute, and errors thrown by the callback propagate.

inputs.name: DetailList.valueClass
inputs.description: Optional callback called as valueClass(row) for each rendered row; its return value becomes the class attribute of the hx-dd description element, and an undefined return omits the attribute. It defaults to undefined, which omits the attribute, and errors thrown by the callback propagate.

outputs.name: DetailList
outputs.description: Renders an hx-dl definition list with one keyed group per row when rows is non-empty, where each group is an hx-div with class detail-row when grouped is true or a bare hx-dt and hx-dd pair when it is false. When rows is empty it renders the empty snippet output if supplied, otherwise an hx-p paragraph reading No details to display.

errors.name: Caller content error
errors.description: Errors thrown by the label, children and empty snippets and by the rowKey, termTitle, valueTitle and valueClass callbacks are raised during rendering and propagate, because this component does not catch them.

errors.name: Duplicate row key
errors.description: Duplicate rowKey values are reported by Svelte's keyed each block as a keyed-each error, which this component does not catch, so callers must provide distinct stable keys.
